terra.problem: The claim that idols cause trouble elsewhere in the Bible needs a reference.
The joke about altar and ark both starting with A makes the answer choices themselves the joke.
The oven joke makes light of the flood immediately alongside God's warning that creatures will perish.
Calling fire a fair guess for a guy who lives next to ovens assumes the baker's gender and circumstances.
The name-tag joke guesses how much time Noah had, though the text gives no such detail.
The passage says the floodwaters came after seven days, not that Noah had seven days to finish packing.
Saying there was no dry corner anywhere when the waters came from below and above suggests the earth was covered at once. The passage describes the waters rising until they covered the mountains.
